phat_hien.so_lieu: 46/47 bài có ≥2 từ nội dung riêng của hook xuất hiện lại trong 180 từ cuối (nhóm CAO 16/16, giữa 15/15, THẤP 15/16). Bài duy nhất không có: 20260506_Why_You_re_Still_Tired_After_Doing_Nothing (4,4 view/ngày). Ngoài ra 29 lần câu 'Go back to…' xuất hiện, phần lớn ở mốc 80-95% bài.
trich: Mở: "Sit still. / Pay attention. / Stop fidgeting." → Kết @94%: "Sit still. / Pay attention. / Stop fidgeting. / Somewhere on a open ground, 50,000 years ago, a child heard none of that." (20260510)
"Go back to that camp one last time. / The fire low and orange. … They belonged to the one keeping everyone else alive. / Those are your eyes." (20260612_Why_Some_Brains_Wake_Up_After_Dark)
"Now, go back to the kid in the chair. / The room waiting. / The sentence that won't hold still. / Here's what was actually happening." (20260604_Why_So_Many_Brilliant_People_Have_Dyslexia)
"Go back to that person in the dark striking rock against rock." (20260527, @82%)
"Tick. / Tick. / Tick. / The clock is still going. / It was always going." (20260729_Why_You_Hear_Every_Sound — mở bằng "T, T, T. That's the clock.")
"Go back to the email you sat down to write. / You didn't lose 11 minutes because you're bad at focusing." (20260514 — nhóm THẤP, cùng thủ pháp)

phat_hien.y: CÂU CẦU NỐI CHUẨN HOÁ 'Now that you know X, you might also want to watch this next video on Y' — kênh có một câu khuôn cứng dùng đi dùng lại gần như nguyên văn ở cuối bài.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 22/47 bài dùng đúng khuôn 'Now that you know/understand/can see…' (CAO 8/16, giữa 7/15, THẤP 7/16). 23/47 bài kết bằng mồi video kế bất kỳ. → CẢ HAI NHÓM.
trich: "Now that you know why the room goes quiet after you do good work, you might also want to watch this next video on why ancient humans never burned out but you do." (20260727)
"Now that you know your brain runs on fuel and not willpower, you might also want to watch this next video on what if people with ADHD ran the modern world." (20260619)

"Now that you know your sensitivity was never fragility, but an orchid waiting for the right place to bloom, you might also want to watch this next video on why some brilliant minds truggle to read." (20260605)

"Now that you can see the two ancient programs deciding your week for you, you might also want to watch this next video n why your brain keeps breaking focus. / Why the thing pulling your attention away was once the thing that kept you alive." (20260731 — bản duy nhất có thêm một câu bán lý do)
"Now that you know the mask was never weakness, but the most expensive thing you've ever done, you might also want to watch this next video on the reasons autistic people go silent." (20260626)

"Now that you know your inability to focus is a survival system doing its job. / If this resonated with you, consider subscribing." (20260514 — nhóm THẤP, cùng cầu nối nhưng rẽ sang xin sub thay vì mồi video)
Biến thể ngắn: "That video is next." (20260510 và 20260722)
Biến thể mạnh nhất: "That video's called Why Some Brains Wake Up After Dark. / It's the other half of this story and it's on screen right now." (20260703)

phat_hien.y: CÂU ĐỊNH DANH NGƯỜI XEM ('That's you' / 'Those are your eyes') RẤT HIẾM nhưng chỉ có ở nhóm trên.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 4/47 bài (CAO 3/16, giữa 1/15, THẤP 0/16).
trich: "They belonged to the one keeping everyone else alive. / Those are your eyes. / You were never failing at mornings. / You were succeeding at the hours the world leaves unguarded." (20260612_Why_Some_Brains_Wake_Up_After_Dark)

"That's not a stranger who only shows up in emergencies. / That's you, finally handed the fuel your brain was always waiting for. / The same you who couldn't start the dishes this morning. / It was always, only ever, the same you." (20260720_Why_You_re_Actually_Best_in_a_Crisis)
"You are the descendant of that person. / The trait didn't survive by accident." (20260705_Why_You_Can_t_Stop_Overthinking)
"You are the animal it was supposed to serve and you were never built to stand in one patch until it's bare." (20260731_Stop_Punishing_Yourself)

phat_hien.y: CÂU XÁ TỘI 'You were never X' đóng vai trò câu chốt cảm xúc, đứng ngay trước cầu nối video kế.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 13/47 bài có câu xá tội trong 180 từ cuối (CAO 5/16, giữa 6/15, THẤP 2/16).
trich: "You were never lazy. / You were running an engine the world forgot to build a road for." (20260619)
"You are never too sensitive. / You are an orchid told to survive like a weed and then blamed for struggling at it." (20260605)
"You were never hearing too much. / You were hearing exactly what you were built to hear in a world that forgot to stay quiet." (20260729)
"That was never igidity. / You just found the one still place in a loud world and you sat down in it." (20260718)
"Your competence is not a character flaw. / It never was. / It is just arriving somewhere that lost the other half of the instructions." (20260727)
"These minds were never wrong. / They were always just expensive." (20260527) — và bản gần như y hệt ở 20260722: "This mind was never wrong. / It was only ever expensive."
"They were never failing to read. / They were reading the one thing the page could never hold." (20260604)

phat_hien.y: 'The next time you…' — chỉ thị hành động rất nhẹ, đặt ngay trước câu chốt. Hiếm và không phân hoá.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 8/47 bài có trong 180 từ cuối (CAO 2/16, giữa 3/15, THẤP 3/16).
trich: "So, the next time you walk into a room and something is off, the mug moved, the word changed, one small thing sitting wrong, you're going to get the look." (20260716)
"The next time you ask for the room to be quieter, ask without apologizing for it." (20260729)

"The next time it goes off, you don't have to silence it. / You just have to recognize the sound. / That's the whole trick, not turning the alarm off. / Learning, finally, to tell a truck from a thief." (20260711)
"The next time someone's mind slips, in your family, on your street, in the seat next to you, don't look away. / Stay a little longer than is comfortable." (20260610)
"So, tonight, when it taps your shoulder, you don't have to argue with it. / You already know what it is. / A held breath, not a verdict." (20260629 — nhóm THẤP)

phat_hien.y: HẠ NHIỆT HAY CHỐT MẠNH: kênh CHỐT MẠNH rồi mới dán cầu nối video kế lên trên. 15/47 bài dừng lạnh hẳn, không mồi không xin gì.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 15/47 bài kết KHÔNG có mồi video kế lẫn CTA (CAO 6/16, giữa 4/15, THẤP 5/16) — dừng đột ngột ngay sau câu chốt.
trich: Dừng lạnh, nhóm CAO: "Not one broken voice, two strong ones. / Both yours, both of them" (20260531 — hết bài, không một chữ mời gì)
Dừng lạnh, nhóm CAO: "It moved. / You didn't imagine it. / You didn't make it a thing. / It was already a thing. / You're just the one who didn't look away." (20260716)

Dừng lạnh, nhóm CAO: "The Ju/'hoansi didn't have a word for it because the fire was always lit and there was always omeone sitting next to it who already knew you. / Not your name. / You. / That's what's missing. / And now, at least, you know what it's called." (20260505)
Dừng lạnh, nhóm CAO: "Sometimes a thing that built the future couldn't sit still long enough to be recognized for it." (20260526)
Dừng lạnh, nhóm THẤP: "It's still looking for the famine. / The famine just never came." (20260507)
Dừng lạnh, nhóm THẤP: "Sometimes it's nice to be slightly terrified of everything." (20260525)

Hạ nhiệt kiểu ngược đời (đuổi người xem đi) — chỉ thấy 1 lần: "The irony of this video taking up your time to tell you to do nothing is not lost on us. / So, what should you do now? / Honestly, turn off this video. / Go sit somewhere with nothing in your hands… 5 minutes. / Your ancestors managed 2 hours, but 5 minutes is a start." (20260506, 4,4 view/ngày)

phat_hien.y: PHÁT HIỆN LỚN: 38/47 bài KHÔNG XIN GÌ CẢ. Kênh gần như không kêu gọi hành động. Khi có, luôn ở 99-100% chiều dài bài, KHÔNG BÀI NÀO xin giữa bài.

Nhóm THẤP xin NHIỀU HƠN nhóm CAO (6 vs 3).

phat_hien.y: BỘ XƯƠNG THỰC ĐO TAY của quả nổ số 1 (238.767 view, 1.529 từ, 8:52): 11 khối, trung bình ~139 từ/khối. Thứ tự leo thang là: buộc tội → dựng thế giới cổ → bẻ chữ (từ 'deficit' sai) → nghiên cứu 1 → cơ chế (gen) → nghiên cứu 2 (CÚ LẬT) → xử lý phản biện → nghiên cứu 3 (khó chịu nhất) → lịch sử cái nhãn → đơn thuốc → bookend + mồi.
phat_hien.so_lieu: Đo tay 1/47 bài (bài top), 11 khối. Vị trí % chính xác từng khối: 0-4% buộc tội+lật luận đề (65 từ) · 5-14% thế giới cổ (145 từ) · 15-22% bẻ chữ 'deficit' (110 từ) · 23-31% nghiên cứu foraging 2024 (130 từ) · 32-40% gen DRD4/7R (130 từ) · 41-51% Eisenberg 2008 + CÚ LẬT (160 từ) · 51-66% hyperfocus, xử phản biện (230 từ) · 66-75% nghiên cứu Thuỵ Điển tháng sinh (145 từ) · 75-87% lịch sử DSM 1968 + nông nghiệp (180 từ) · 87-94% đơn thuốc (110 từ) · 94-100% bookend + mồi (95 từ).
trich: Khối 6 là cú lật, nằm ở 49-51%: "In the settled group, same gene, same tribe, same generation, those men were worse nourished than those without it. / Not slightly worse. / The advantage had completely flipped. / Same gene, same people, same century, two different environments, two completely opposite outcomes. / The gene didn't change. / The room did." (20260510)

"Here's where it gets stranger." @39% (20260527)

"Here's where it gets strange." @22% (20260518)

phat_hien.y: KHUÔN 1 — MỞ CHƯƠNG BẰNG NGHIÊN CỨU CÓ NIÊN ĐẠI + TÊN + NƠI. Câu mở dài, đầy danh từ riêng; câu đóng chương trước luôn NGẮN, tạo nhịp dài-ngắn.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 80 lần câu mở đầu bằng 'In <năm>,' trên 47 bài (36 lần ở nhóm CAO, 19 giữa, 25 THẤP). Trung vị độ dài câu mở chương: 9 từ; nhưng riêng câu mở kiểu nghiên cứu dài 25-60 từ.
trich: ĐÓNG (10 từ): "It said nothing about what he brain actually was." → MỞ (12 từ): "So in 2024, a team of researchers decided to find out." (20260510, @24%)

ĐÓNG (7 từ): "So, researchers went looking for living proof." → MỞ (24 từ): "In 2008, an anthropologist named Dan Eisenberg traveled to northern Kenya to study a tribe called the Aari al." (20260510, @43%)

ĐÓNG (8 từ): "But, the tools are only the beginning." → MỞ (54 từ): "In 2010, a researcher named Simon Baron-Cohen, not the comedian, the Cambridge psychologist, published a paper arguing that what we call the autistic cognitive style is essentially a drive to systematize, to find the rules inside a system, to map it, master it, repeat it until it's perfect." (20260527, @27%)

ĐÓNG (5 từ): "That's a cognitive signature." → MỞ (5 từ): "Here's where it gets stranger." → MỞ TIẾP (48 từ): "In 2017, archaeologist Derek Hodgson published an analysis of Paleolithic ave paintings, the ones in Lascaux, Altamira, Chauvet, the ones that stopped experts cold when they were first discovered because they shouldn't exist, not at that level." (20260527, @39-42%)
ĐÓNG (4 từ): "Then the brain scanners arrived." → MỞ (16 từ): "In 2011, Judzia Jagiellowicz scanned sensitive people while they spotted tiny differences between photos." (20260605, @42%)
ĐÓNG (4 từ): "Most people do." → MỞ (18 từ): "In 2014, two researchers named Eugene Kim and Teresa Glomb went looking for that exact silence." (20260727, @19%)

ĐÓNG (6 từ): "The genes didn't disappear." → MỞ (33 từ): "In 2019 a large-scale genomic study found that many of the genetic variants associated with autism have been present in the human population for at least 100,000 years." (20260527, @79%)

phat_hien.y: KHUÔN 2 — MỞ CHƯƠNG BẰNG MỆNH LỆNH 2-6 TỪ ('Picture…', 'Think of it as…', 'Go back to…'). Đây là câu chuyển ngắn nhất và dùng nhiều nhất.
phat_hien.so_lieu: Trung vị câu mở chương = 9 từ trên 191 cặp chuyển đo được. Riêng nhóm mệnh lệnh: 'go back' 29 lần / 24 bài, 'picture/imagine' 27 lần / 20 bài, 'think about/of' 29 lần / 20 bài.

"Go back a long way first, tens of thousands of years." (10 từ, 20260720 @5%)
"Go back to that camp, but in daylight." (8 từ, 20260605 @33%)
"Rewind the clock." (3 từ, 20260614 @51%)
"Go back a very long way." (6 từ, 20260729 @29%)

phat_hien.y: KHUÔN 3 — ĐÓNG CHƯƠNG BẰNG CÂU CỤT ĐỐI XỨNG rồi để câu 'Here's…' kéo sang chương sau. Câu đóng thường ≤8 từ và là một mệnh đề đảo.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 27/47 bài dùng cặp [câu đóng cụt] + ['Here's…']. Trên toàn kênh, 27% câu dài ≤5 từ (nhóm CAO 27%, nhóm THẤP 23%) → nhịp cụt là NẾT chung.

ĐÓNG: "They don't." → MỞ: "Here's how the engineer pays attention." (20260531 @55%)
ĐÓNG: "First, the thing." → MỞ: "Imagine attention is water." (20260531 @57%)
ĐÓNG: "That's the feeling." → MỞ: "And here's the fear underneath it, the one almost nobody says out loud." (20260531 @13%)
ĐÓNG: "The traits didn't change, the world did." → MỞ: "And here's the part that should sit with you." (20260527 @77%)
ĐÓNG: "The genome kept the receipt." → MỞ: "Go back to that person in the dark striking rock against rock." (20260527 @82%)
ĐÓNG: "The environment just rarely gives it anything worth hunting." → MỞ: "Here's where it gets genuinely uncomfortable." (20260510 @67%)
ĐÓNG: "There just wasn't enough in the tank yet o move." → MỞ: "Picture a hill." (20260720 @37%)

phat_hien.y: KHUÔN 4 — CHUYỂN BẰNG CÂU HỎI TU TỪ ĐẶT NGAY TRƯỚC CẢNH MỚI.
phat_hien.so_lieu: Chỉ 21/47 bài có dấu hỏi trong 130 từ đầu, nhưng câu hỏi ở giữa bài thì thường đứng đúng chỗ giao chương. Đếm trên 191 cặp chuyển: câu đóng là câu hỏi ở khoảng 1/6 số cặp.
trich: ĐÓNG (câu hỏi): "Why would a group that needs food punish the person who finds it?" → MỞ: "Picture a band of 30 people and one hunter better than all of them." (20260727 @51%)
ĐÓNG: "Now, there's an obvious question. / If this brain is so well-built, why does it cause so much real pain?" → MỞ: "Here's what the diagnosis leaves out." (20260510 @52-54%)
"What did they know that we forgot?" (20260610, @5% — chuyển từ cảnh cổ sang phần dữ liệu)
"So what broke between yesterday and today?" (20260622, @2%)

phat_hien.y: CÓ NÊU TÊN NHÀ NGHIÊN CỨU, NĂM, NƠI — mật độ cao và đều. Đây là NẾT của kênh: cả bài nổ lẫn bài chìm đều neo bằng nghiên cứu.
phat_hien.so_lieu: 120 mốc năm trên 47 bài (1,35 mốc/1000 từ). Nhóm CAO 1,76/1000 từ (14/16 bài) · giữa 1,05 (14/15) · THẤP 1,27 (13/16). Tên nhà nghiên cứu kèm chức danh: 52 lần, CAO 0,62/1000 từ (11/16 bài) vs THẤP 0,58 (8/16) — gần như y hệt. Tên trường/viện: CAO 0,34 vs THẤP 0,33.

"In 2003, a neuroscientist named Naomi Eisenberger sat volunteers down in front of computers at UCLA and had them play a simple digital game." (20260516 — nhóm THẤP, mỏ neo chuẩn y hệt bài nổ)
